description: The custom properties a site may set that are not tokens (#80). The kit and the components read them with a default, so a site sets one only to change that default. A check for counterfeit tokens reads this list, and the identity names in dist/hooks.json, before it reports a name tokens.css does not define.

hooks.name: --ij-display-weight
hooks.for: The display face's weight, for a face whose regular weight reads too light

hooks.name: --ij-wordmark-em
hooks.for: The closing wordmark's width in em, so it never runs past its column

hooks.name: --ij-footer-links-justify
hooks.for: How the footer's link rows align
